notes: Two ways a report came out incomplete. A grid's Grand Total row and its frozen Action column are built from sticky cells, and every sticky thing was hidden after the first screen to stop page headers repeating - so those rows were deleted from the picture, with nothing to say so. Now only what can actually follow the window is hidden: a cell locked inside a grid's own scroll box cannot, and stays. And a table wider than its panel is opened to its full width before a full page capture, so the columns off to the right are in the screenshot instead of waiting behind a scrollbar.
